name: M6.ActualTransfer.window_conv

queries: finite product sum equivalence cyclic convolution
guidance: Extend Fin(R+1) sum to Fin N by zero coefficients above natDegree, transport Fin N to ZMod N. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
